summary: Examples of the config lookup showing the default become user, role paths, retry file path with default, multiple color settings, skipping unknown keys, and ssh/sh plugin settings.
questions: How do I print the configured roles path?
How do I get the ssh connection's remote_user and port settings?
How do I look up several config values at once?

answer_card.title: config lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug: msg="{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.config', 'DEFAULT_BECOME_USER') }}"

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Role paths: {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.config', 'DEFAULT_ROLES_PATH') }}"

- ansible.builtin.find:
    paths: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.config', 'RETRY_FILES_SAVE_PATH') | default(playbook_dir, True) }}"
    patterns: "*.retry"

- ansible.builtin.debug: msg="{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.config', 'COLOR_OK', 'COLOR_CHANGED', 'COLOR_SKIP', wantlist=True) }}"

- ansible.builtin.debug: msg={{ q("ansible.builtin.config", "remote_user", "port", plugin_type="connection", plugin_name="ssh", on_missing='skip') }}

- ansible.builtin.debug: msg={{ q("ansible.builtin.config", "remote_tmp", plugin_type="shell", plugin_name="sh") }}
```
